buttons.btnCopy:
Copies the name of the selected layer, if no layer is selected,
the value of the first available one is copied
buttons.btnFavorites: Add or remove a preset from favorites
buttons.btnSave:
Saves the value from the name template input field to the presets.
Shift + Click - Updates the values of the selected preset
buttons.btnCircleMinus: Delete the currently selected template in the preset list.
buttons.btnRename:
Click – apply the template.
Shift + Click – add the template value to the beginning of the layer name.
Ctrl + Click – add the value to the end of the layer name.
buttons.btnVariables: Open the variable values panel for the layer.
buttons.btnHelp: Open the library of all variables and their modes.
buttons.btnReset:
Reset all values.
(Does not delete presets and variable settings)
buttons.btnSettings:
Open the variable settings panel.
Click - forward.
Ctrl + Click - back.
Alt + Click - activate.
buttons.btnModeSwitch_chart:
By frequency of use (descending).
Click - forward.
Ctrl + Click - back.
Alt + Click - activate.
buttons.btnModeSwitch_date:
By date of addition (ascending).
Click - forward.
Ctrl + Click - back.
Alt + Click - activate.
buttons.btnModeSwitch_longArrowDown:
By number of characters (descending).
Click - forward.
Ctrl + Click - back.
Alt + Click - activate.
buttons.btnModeSwitch_longArrowUp:
By number of characters (ascending).
Click - forward.
Ctrl + Click - back.
Alt + Click - activate.
buttons.btnModeSwitch_favorites:
Favorites only.
Click - forward.

buttons.btnModeSwitch_search:
Finding the right value.
Click - forward.

radioButtons.rdoAllLayers: All available layers in this composition will be used.
radioButtons.rdoOnlySelected: Only the layers you select will be affected.

dropdowns.ddLayerMode: Select a name template from saved presets.
